trials.instruction: Use the left arm to pick the ceramic mug with cartoons, turn it, place it, then hang on the dark gray rack.
With the left arm, grab the mug with round handle from the table, rotate it, place it centrally, and with the right arm, hang it onto the smooth rack.
Pick the green drinking mug from the table, rotate it, place it, and then hang it onto the smooth rack.
Pick the light beige ceramic drinking mug from the table using one hand, rotate, and hang it on the smooth rack.
Take the mug with cartoon design with one arm, rotate it, and hang it onto the dark gray angled rack.
Use the left arm to pick the ceramic mug, turn it, place it, then hang on the metal rack.
Pick up the cylindrical coffee mug with handle, turn it, place it centrally, then hang the cylindrical coffee mug with handle onto the metal rack.
Pick the starbucks green mug up, twist it, place it back, then hang it onto the metallic angular rack with rod pair.
With the left arm, grab the black coffee mug from the table, rotate it, place it centrally, and with the right arm, hang it onto the metallic angular rack with rod pair.
Pick the ceramic mug, turn it, put it in the center, and transfer it to the rack with two rods sticking out.
